info.title: EscrowPay Merchant API
info.description: Public merchant integration surface. Authenticate with your API key via the `X-API-Key` header. JWT / dashboard tokens are not supported here. Import this OpenAPI document into ReadMe or other portals. Webhook endpoint management, contact form, and merchant audit/configuration routes are not part of this surface.

get.description:
Resolve the calling credential's business / app-env / merchant environment.

``environment`` here is the **merchant credential environment**
(`test` | `live`), not the API deploy runtime on `GET /health`
(`local` | `staging` | `production`).
Probe whether the calling credential holds a given scope (allow/deny).
Curated test NIN/BVN fixtures (test environment only; never Prembly).
List banks for payout/resolve pickers (dummy set in test, full catalog in live).

post.description: Name enquiry for bank_code + account_number (simulator in test, Rubies in live).

Onboard a **new** person: create identity, verify KYC, and bind a Party.

Use this when the person does **not** already have a verified EscrowPay
identity. KYC fee applies on **live** verify only (waived in test).

Returns **201** only when a party is created (or already bound). Failed /
review KYC returns **422** (`identity_verification_failed` or
`identity_requires_review`) — no party is created.

If you already have a verified `identity_id`, use `POST /parties` instead.

Create a Party from an **already-verified** identity (no KYC fee).

Requires `identity_id` for an identity whose verification_status is
`verified`. Unknown ids return **404** `resource_not_found`.

For a new person (identity + verify + party in one step), use
`POST /parties/onboard` instead.

get.description: List parties in the calling context
Read a party with identity and payout-account summaries.

patch.description: Update, restrict, or archive a party.

post.description: Attach an encrypted identity to exactly one same-tenant subject.

get.description: Read a masked identity and its latest verification.

post.description: Start a verification attempt (provider chosen by configuration).

get.description: List safe, normalized verification attempts for an identity.

post.description: Register a bank destination (auto name-enquiry on create for test and live).

get.description: List payout destinations in the calling context.
Read a masked payout destination and its eligibility.

patch.description: Set default, disable, or archive a payout account.

post.description: Resolve/verify a payout account via the configured bank resolver.

Create a draft escrow transaction.

Enum fields (`type`, `funding_mode`, `release_policy`, `refund_policy`,
`payout_preference`) are lowercase wire values. Invalid values return **422**
with the allowed list — never HTTP 500.

Create a checkout session for an activated transaction.

All body fields are optional. Send `{}`, omit `allowed_channels`, or omit
the JSON body entirely — Core defaults `allowed_channels` to
`["bank_transfer"]`. For `partial_allowed` transactions, optional
`milestone_id` / `amount_minor` create a session for the next milestone
or a principal slice instead of remaining project amount.

get.description:
Liveness probe.

``data.environment`` and ``data.runtime`` are the **API deploy runtime**
(`local` | `staging` | `production`). They are **not** the merchant
credential environment (`test` | `live`). For that, call
`GET /credential-context` with `X-API-Key`.

allowed_channels.title: Allowed Channels
allowed_channels.description: Channels the payer may use. Currently only `bank_transfer` is supported. Omit this field (or send []) to default to bank_transfer. You may omit the HTTP body entirely or send `{}`; a JSON object is not required when every field uses its default.

success_url.title: Success Url
success_url.description: Optional redirect after success (must match app env allowed domains).

cancel_url.title: Cancel Url
cancel_url.description: Optional redirect after cancel (must match app env allowed domains).

amount_minor.title: Amount Minor
amount_minor.description: Optional escrow principal for this session. Allowed only when the transaction `funding_mode` is `partial_allowed`. Must not exceed remaining unfunded principal. Omit to charge the full remaining amount (full-project checkout).

milestone_id.title: Milestone Id
milestone_id.description: Optional milestone to fund next. Allowed only when `funding_mode` is `partial_allowed`. Derives session `amount_minor` from the milestone remainder. Must be the next unfunded milestone in sequence. If `amount_minor` is also sent, it must match that remainder.

subject_type.title: Subject Type
subject_type.description: party | business; omit for unbound KYC

identity_id.title: Identity Id
identity_id.description: Verified identity id (`IDN_…`). Unknown or unverified ids are rejected.

PartyCreate.title: PartyCreate
PartyCreate.description: Bind a Party to an already-verified identity. For new people use POST /parties/onboard.

PartyOnboard.title: PartyOnboard
PartyOnboard.description: New person: identity + KYC + Party in one call. Prefer this over POST /parties.

funding_mode.description: `exact` requires the full remaining amount; `partial_allowed` accepts underpayment.

release_policy.description: When omitted, Core uses the business financial-control default (typically `manual_only`). Allowed: `manual_only`, `automatic_only`, `manual_with_automatic_fallback`, `held_until_configured`.

refund_policy.description: When omitted, Core uses the business financial-control default (typically `manual_only`). Allowed: `disabled`, `manual_only`, `automatic_only`, `manual_with_automatic_fallback`.

marketplace_commission_bps.title: Marketplace Commission Bps
marketplace_commission_bps.description: Optional marketplace commission for this transaction (basis points). When set, overrides the business default from PATCH /fees/configuration. Omit or null to inherit the business default.

marketplace_commission_bps.title: Marketplace Commission Bps
marketplace_commission_bps.description: Set to override business default commission for this draft. Send null to clear the override and inherit again.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Merchant API credential (secret, restricted, or public key). JWT access tokens are not accepted on this surface.
